reason: I run a real service centre with staff to pay, and my margin on a PPF or tint job is already thin. Taking 10% of every order before I even see the money is a lot, and I have no way of knowing yet whether these customers are worth it.
objection: Ten percent off the top on jobs where I'm already fighting for every riyal. I'd be paying them for customers I could partly win with my own Instagram and walk-ins.
would_change_my_mind: A lower commission on the first few orders, or a clear record showing these leads close often enough that the 10% pays for itself.
